subject.title: fix(models): strip plaintext api keys from models json

question: Should this protected branch be rebased or replaced now to cover current root and plugin catalog writers, or kept parked until the post-PI model registry direction lands?
rationale: The patch changes credential persistence and request-auth semantics in a security-sensitive surface, and the author already noted a possible wait-for-PI-removal direction.

options.title: Rebase or replace now
options.body: Update the fix against current main so both generated catalog outputs are sanitized and marker runtime behavior is covered by tests and proof.

options.title: Adopt another related branch
options.body: Use a related PR only after it is cleanly mergeable, proof-positive, and covers this PR's custom-provider marker compatibility cases.

options.title: Keep parked for registry direction
options.body: Leave this branch open as source material until maintainers choose the post-PI auth-storage and model-registry design.

recommendation.title: Rebase or replace now
recommendation.body: Update the fix against current main so both generated catalog outputs are sanitized and marker runtime behavior is covered by tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the final marker fixup and left the explicit comment about waiting for PI-removal work before landing this behavior.
